def facts():
    a = DEV.alloc(64)
    DEV.write(a, b"\xff" * 32)
    DEV.write(a, b"\x01" * 10)
    after = DEV.read(a, 32).hex()
    short = len(DEV.read(a, 10))
    DEV.free(a)
    return {"line": DEV.card.line, "granule": MACHINE.card.host.write_granule, "after": after, "short_read": short}
